plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's feelings. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The challenge is that words can move faster than the body. This person may name the feeling before you are ready to process it. They may explain what is happening inside you when what you really need is time to feel it for yourself.
advice: Let the conversation help you, but do not let it rush you. The point is not to turn every feeling into a sentence right away. The point is to feel understood without losing touch with your own pace.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
